item.description: GUWAHATI: IndiGo is likely to resume normal operations between December 10–15 after a week of strain that peaked on December 5, when chief executive Pieter Elbers also delivered a public apology and acknowledged the scale of the airline’s collapse. item.description: GUWAHATI: In a significant policy change, the Assam government on Friday, December 5, relaxed the two-child norm for Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), tea garden communities, Moran and Matak groups, allowing up to three children for eligibility in government employment, elections and Self Help Group (SHG) incentives.
